title: Mathematical Reasoning via Intervention-Based Time-Series Causal Discovery Using LLMs as Concept Mastery Simulators
abstract: arXiv:2605.07600v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent methods for improving LLM mathematical reasoning, whether through MCTS-based test-time search or causal graph-guided knowledge injection, cannot identify which concepts causally contribute to a correct answer, as the observed association may be spurious, driven by confounders such as problem difficulty.   We propose CIKA (Causal Intervention for Knowledge Activation), a framework that uses the LLM itself as an interventional simulator: a prompt sets the concept state to ``mastered'' and the correctness change estimates the causal effect. We formalize this quantity as an Interventional Capability Probe (ICP), which diagnoses whether the LLM can use a given concept -- distinct from merely possessing knowledge. Because the intervention exogenously sets the concept state independently of problem difficulty, ICP separates confounding that observational methods cannot. translated_title: 基于干预式时间序列因果发现的数学推理：以大语言模型作为概念掌握模拟器
translated_abstract: 近期改进大语言模型（LLM）数学推理的方法，无论是基于MCTS的测试时搜索还是因果图引导的知识注入，都无法识别哪些概念在因果上真正促成了正确答案，因为观察到的关联可能是虚假的，由题目难度等混杂因素所驱动。我们提出CIKA（面向知识激活的因果干预）框架，该框架将LLM自身用作干预模拟器：通过提示词将概念状态设定为“已掌握”，并以正确率的变化来估计因果效应。我们将这一量度形式化为干预能力探针（ICP），用于诊断LLM能否实际使用某个给定概念——这不同于仅仅拥有相关知识。由于干预以方式外生地设定概念状态、独立于题目难度，ICP能够分离观察性方法无法分离的混杂因素。在筛选出的67道题目上，排名最高概念的ICP……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出CIKA框架，将大语言模型自身作为干预模拟器，通过把概念状态干预为“已掌握”并测量正确率变化来估计因果效应，从而识别真正在因果上促成正确答案的概念，克服了题目难度等混杂因素造成的虚假关联。
en_tdlr: CIKA uses the LLM itself as an interventional simulator—setting a concept to "mastered" via prompting and measuring correctness changes—to identify concepts that causally contribute to correct answers, separating confounders like problem difficulty that observational methods cannot.
